notes.subject: hais ples
notes.rationale: במה em i ples antap we ol i wosipim — 'hais ples bilong olsem'; 'hais ples' i no holim olgeta mining

notes.subject: לא באות ולא יהיה
notes.rationale: 'olgeta samting olsem i no ken kamap, na bai no kamap' — o 'em i no ken kamap' (samel singgular); ol tanim tok i no wanbel

notes.subject: ⟨i⟩ na ⟨em⟩
notes.rationale: Tok Pisin i laikim predikat marker na pronau; Hibru i no gat

translation: Na yu kisim samting long ol klos bilong yu, na yu wokim long yu ol hais ples i gat ol kala, na yu mekim pasin prostitut long ol; olgeta samting olsem ⟨i⟩ no inap kamap, na ⟨em⟩ bai no kamap.

tokens.gloss: samting long ol klos bilong yu
